3 04-09-2025 The instant application has been filed by the petitioner under Article 226 of the Constitution of India, praying for the following relief(s):
"(i) For that Plot no.1087, 1088, 1089, 1090, 1091 & 1092 of Khata no. 38, Thana no.79, Mauza- Khardeur, District- West Champaran is recorded in name of Jhaman Dubey and Butai Dubey and the petitioner is grandson of aforesaid Jhaman Dubey and aforesaid land is raiyati land of the petitioner and Plot No.126, 128 of Khata No.101 and Plot No.10 of khata No.107, Plot Patna High Court CWJC No.18006 of 2021(3) dt.04-09-2025 No.117 of Khata No.108, Plot No.121 and 122 of Khata No.104, Plot No.5 of Khata No.98 total area
about 40

total area about 15

sentences.text: (ii) For that no notice was issued and served upon petitioner for acquiring the aforesaid land of the petitioner for construction of aforesaid road although the petitioner is paying revenue to State of Bihar and rent receipt is being granted to petitioner and name of petitioner is recorded in Revenue records of State of Bihar.

(iii) For that petitioner met several times to the authorities concerned personally and filed representation before respondent no. 3 to 7 from 2020 and lastly sent representation through registered post 17.07.2021 and requested payment of compensation to on make money, but no reply was given till date.
(iv) For that respondents are legally bound to make payment of adequate compensation amount to petitioner and petitioner has got legal right to receive the same for loss caused by arbitrary actions of respondents.
(v) For that petitioner is a farmer and agriculturist and the fundamental right under Article 21 of Constitution has been infringed as the cultivation is the only source of livelihood of Patna High Court CWJC No.18006 of 2021(3) dt.04-09-2025 the petitioner."
2.
Heard Mr. Binay Kant Mani Tripathi, learned counsel appearing for the petitioner and Mr. Asif Kalim, learned counsel appearing for the State.

3. The main grievance raised by the petitioner is that his land measuring about 55 decimals, details of which are mentioned in the paragraph no. 3 of the petition, has been used by the government authorities for road construction without being acquired and without paying any compensation to the petitioner.

According to the petitioner's counsel for redressing his grievance, he has filed a representation dated 17.07.2021 before the District Magistrate-cum- District Land Acquisition Officer, West Champaran, Bettiah vide Annexure-1, upon which no action has been taken by the said officer despite the lapse of several years and the petitioner has been running from pillar to post.

entities.text: District Magistrate-cum- District Land Acquisition Officer, West Champaran, Bettiah
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
4. Considering the petitioner's grievance, the instant writ petition stands disposed of with a direction to the District Magistrate-cum-District Land Acquisition Officer, West Champaran, Bettiah to look into the petitioner's grievance raised in the petitioner's application dated 17.07.2021 and to take appropriate remedial action to redress the petitioner's grievance within six weeks from the date of receipt or production of this Patna High Court CWJC No.18006 of 2021(3) dt.04-09-2025 order's copy and the petitioner shall also be informed in writing regarding the action taken.
(Shailendra Singh, J) Rajiv/-
